cells: mesm-tts (mesmertech), Hugging Face repo `mesmertech/mesm-tts`, pinned revision `aa59535a8c2b1cf7b0229956ceb26d7f62ef7a14`: the `web/v2/` browser bundle (pdn WebAssembly engine, misaki-lite JavaScript phonemizer, Heart `v2f_lite` weights)

**Apache-2.0 - verified 2026-11-05** from the repo `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` at the pinned revision and the HF model API `cardData.license: apache-2.0`. the bundle's own LICENSES file (`web/v2/`) at the revision states the engine, loader, weights, tokenizer, misaki-lite port and lexicons are Apache-2.0. Teachers, each Apache-2.0 per the NOTICE and the HF API: `hexgrad/Kokoro-82M` (voice af_heart, teacher of Heart), `gradium/phonon-31m-en` and `sahilmahendrakar/Paradee-8M-v1.1` (starting weights of the Heart decoder). eSpeak NG (GPL-3.0-or-later) is the optional out-of-lexicon fallback: NOT shipped; `frontend/kokoro-phonemize.mjs` (which imports it) is omitted and `espeak-refused.mjs` replaces the loader, so an out-of-lexicon word fails that turn's synthesis and the turn plays caption-only. The voices are synthetic; the NOTICE forbids impersonating a real person.

16 files, 6.5 MB, served from `apps/ui-xr/public/mesm-tts/` (repo precedent: `public/generated-humanoids/` ships multi-MB runtime GLBs): `paradee.mjs`, `paradee-worker.mjs`, `player-worklet.js`, `engine/{pdn.mjs,pdn.wasm,pdn_r.wasm}`, `frontend/{tokenizer.mjs,tokenizer.json,misaki_lite.mjs,espeak_chain.mjs,misaki.js,us_gold.fc.txt,us_silver.fc.txt}`, `models/v2f_lite.pdn` (2.67 MB), `LICENSE`, `NOTICE.txt`, `SOURCE.json` (revision + sha256 per file), plus the repo-authored `espeak-refused.mjs`. Every upstream file sha256-verified against `web/v2/SHA256SUMS` at the revision. Full upstream copy and manifest: `/Volumes/files/openclinxr-assets/store/mesm-tts/aa59535a/` (`manifest.json`). Omitted: `v2f`/`v2g` weights, the nine phonon voices (`pv` engine), lexicon shards.

C30 (xr-sync): `packages/openclinxr/xr-sync-client/src/actor-voice*.ts` speaks the server-authoritative actor turn caption on the production shell (`apps/ui-xr`) in a module Worker; per-actor voice from the scenario actor field `ttsVoice` (default Heart). Runtime on-device synthesis, no network at exam time, no audio stored in traces (replay re-synthesizes from the recorded caption text).

**Keep.** Permissive code, weights and teachers, no network calls at run time. Only Heart is wired; the other nine voices need the `pv` engine and resolve to Heart with `voiceFallback: true` in the shell evidence.
